title: Topic 18: Clothes & Colours - Writing
canDoStatement: Name clothes and colours; describe what people are wearing

writingTask.writingPrompt:
PROMPT:
  Write a text: What we wear.
  You today, you in winter or summer, and one person
  you know.

Minimum requirements:
  - 6 sentences
  - I am wearing... (now) AND I wear... (habit) - both!
  - 3+ clothes words, 2+ colours
  - One sentence about another person (is wearing /
    wears - watch the -s!)
wordBank: white (green and yellow appear in texts as passive exposure - tested colours are the big four)
